class.name: OcgSelect3dSensitivegroup
class.brief_description: A framework to define selection of a sensitive group by a sensitive entity which is a set of 3D sensitive entities. Remark: 2 modes are possible for rectangle selection the group is considered selected 1) when all the entities inside are selected in the rectangle 2) only one entity inside is selected by the rectangle By default the "Match All entities" mode is set.
class.description: ! A framework to define selection of a sensitive group ! by a sensitive entity which is a set of 3D sensitive entities. ! Remark: 2 modes are possible for rectangle selection ! the group is considered selected ! 1) when all the entities inside are selected in the rectangle ! 2) only one entity inside is selected by the rectangle ! By default the "Match All entities" mode is set.

method.name: Add
method.description: Adds the sensitive entity aSensitive to the non-empty sensitive group object created at construction time.

method.name: Clear
method.description: Removes all sensitive entities from the list used at the time of construction, or added using the function Add.

method.name: IsIn
method.description: Returns true if the sensitive entity aSensitive is in the list used at the time of construction, or added using the function Add.

method.name: SetMatchType
method.description: Sets the requirement that all sensitive entities in the list used at the time of construction, or added using the function Add must be matched.

method.name: Set
method.description: Sets the owner for all entities in group

method.name: BoundingBox
method.description: Returns bounding box of the group. If location transformation is set, it will be applied

method.name: CenterOfGeometry
method.description: Returns center of entity set. If location transformation is set, it will be applied

method.name: Box
method.description: Returns bounding box of sensitive entity with index theIdx

method.name: Center
method.description: Returns geometry center of sensitive entity index theIdx in the vector along the given axis theAxis

method.name: Swap
method.description: Swaps items with indexes theIdx1 and theIdx2 in the vector

method.name: Size
method.description: Returns the length of vector of sensitive entities

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
